classification.classification_reason: The article discusses a rare genetic disorder affecting an 18-month-old boy and the YSR Congress Party's assistance in providing financial and medical support.

content.title: YSR Congress Party Assists 18-Month-Old Boy with Spinal Muscular Atrophy
content.caption: YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) promises financial assistance to 18-month-old boy suffering from Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA).

slides.heading: YSR Congress Party Assists SMA Patient
slides.text: YSR Congress Party promises financial assistance to 18-month-old boy suffering from Spinal Muscular Atrophy.
slides.image_search_query: YSR Congress Party, 18-month-old boy, Spinal Muscular Atrophy India

slides.heading: The Boy's Condition
slides.text: The boy suffers from Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA), a rare genetic disorder requiring treatment costing nearly ₹1.5 crore.
slides.image_search_query: Spinal Muscular Atrophy, genetic disorder India

slides.heading: Parents' Financial Struggles
slides.text: The boy's parents, accompanied by YSRCP spokesperson, met Mr. Jagan at Tadepalli and explained their financial difficulties and the need for urgent medical intervention.
slides.image_search_query: parents, financial difficulties, urgent medical intervention India

slides.heading: YSRCP's Response
slides.text: YSRCP leader assured the family that all necessary assistance would be extended from his side, and arranged passports and facilitated medical tests.
